set.title: Ingomar’s North Half volleyball match was scheduled for Monday, Oct. 12
set.excerpt: Ingomar’s Lady Falcons were scheduled to face TCPS at 6 p.m. Monday, Oct. 12, at Ingomar for a state-final berth.
set.content:
The Ingomar Lady Falcons were scheduled to face TCPS in the North Half volleyball championship at 6 p.m. Monday, Oct. 12, at Ingomar.

The school’s announcement encouraged students to wear Hawaiian-themed attire and fans to support the team.

Correction (Oct. 13, 2026): The match was scheduled for Monday, Oct. 12, not Tuesday.

Source: Ingomar Attendance Center announcement

posts.note: Monday date supplied in parent verified ledger; independent caption confirms teams, place, time, attire.

set.title: Ingomar faces Resurrection in Friday’s Class 1A volleyball final
set.excerpt: Ingomar meets Resurrection at noon Friday, Oct. 16, at Mississippi College’s A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton.
set.content:
The Ingomar Lady Falcons have advanced to the Class 1A state volleyball championship, according to Ingomar Attendance Center’s announcement.

The MHSAA championship schedule lists Ingomar against Resurrection at noon Friday, Oct. 16, at Mississippi College’s A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton.

The final is this week. The MHSAA schedule links to GoFan for tickets and the NFHS Network for the livestream.

Source: Ingomar Attendance Center and the MHSAA championship schedule.

set.title: New Albany earns Class 4A volleyball final berth; faces Choctaw Central Friday
set.excerpt: New Albany faces Choctaw Central at 2 p.m. Friday, Oct. 16, at Mississippi College’s A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton.
set.content:
New Albany is listed in the Class 4A state volleyball final against Choctaw Central on the MHSAA championship schedule.

The final is scheduled for 2 p.m. Friday, Oct. 16, at Mississippi College’s A.E. Wood Coliseum in Clinton. Friday’s schedule also includes the Class 3A match at 10 a.m. and the Class 1A match at noon.

The MHSAA schedule provides the Class 4A GoFan ticket link and lists the NFHS Network as the livestream provider. Readers can use the official schedule to check current event information.

Sources: Original New Albany announcement and the MHSAA championship schedule.
